WeMall — Created within the WeAIT Ecosystem

Care products, with a clearer path from choice to purchase.

WeMall connects people with products that support independence, safety, wellbeing and everyday living.

As part of the WeAIT digital care ecosystem, WeMall brings together customers, families, care teams and trusted suppliers in one connected marketplace. From product discovery and comparison to quotes, funding pathways, approvals and purchasing, WeMall helps make the journey simpler, clearer and more informed.

Whether purchasing through Support at Home, NDIS or privately, WeMall supports greater choice and easier access to the products people need to live well and independently.

Know what needs to happen before you order.

  1. Explore the product — Review specifications, suitability information and supplier details.

  2. Check the requirements — Confirm whether professional advice, an assessment or a prescription is needed.

  3. Confirm the purchase pathway — For funded purchases, check eligibility, approval and any amount you may need to pay.

  4. Confirm fulfilment — Review delivery, installation, returns and warranty arrangements before placing an order.
